reading.passage: The old lighthouse keeper climbed the spiral stairs every evening, rain or shine, to light the lamp that guided ships safely past the rocks.
reading.question: What is the main idea?
reading.correct: The keeper reliably lit the lamp to keep ships safe.
wrong: Ships avoided the lighthouse on purpose.
The lamp was broken most nights.

reading.passage: Maria practiced the violin for an hour every day after school, even when she felt tired, because she had a recital coming up in June.
reading.question: Why did Maria keep practicing?
reading.correct: She had an upcoming recital to prepare for.
wrong: She didn't enjoy playing the violin.
Her teacher forced her to practice.

reading.passage: After the storm knocked out power for three days, the neighbors set up a shared grill in the street so no one's food would go to waste.
reading.question: What does this passage mainly show?
reading.correct: People working together during a hard situation.

reading.passage: Even though the trail was steep and the fog made it hard to see, the hikers kept moving, checking their map at every fork in the path.
reading.question: What best describes the hikers?
reading.correct: Careful and persistent despite difficult conditions.
wrong: Lost and about to give up.
Racing each other to the top.
